title: Stamp Duty and Registration Charges in India 2026: State-Wise Table With Women's Concession
seoTitle: Stamp Duty and Registration Charges 2026: State-Wise Table
seoDescription: Stamp duty is 4-8% and registration 1-2% in most big states, charged on the higher of circle rate and agreement value. See 8 states and women's rates.
excerpt: Eight states' current rates in one sourced table, including women's concessions, metro cess and registration fee caps, plus worked examples showing how the circle rate decides what you actually pay.
